version.author: kallums
version.changelog: First release through ReaPack. Build instruments that don't exist from parts - energy source, exciter, vibrating element, coupler, resonator, radiator - and the materials they are made of, and play them from a MIDI keyboard.

metadata.description: {\pard Instrument Creator\par Build instruments that don't exist, from parts, and play them from a MIDI keyboard: a glass trumpet, a violin made of ice, a marimba of marble bars.\par Pick one option for each part and what the element and resonator are made of; the sound is worked out from the physics of the parts.\par }
